history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Yes, speaking.
Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Yes it's Sam, I've been meaning to ring you actually.
Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
You've got the wrong person, sorry.

scenarios.name: THIRD PARTY (patient out) -> not_available, no detail

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
He's not home, I'm his brother.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Try again another time; not_available; nothing about visits or booking.

scenarios.name: WHO IS THIS -> re-identify, no tool

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Who's calling?

scenarios.expected_behavior: AI Jane from the clinic, asks if they are Sam.

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
I'm driving, sorry.
Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
The person you are trying to reach is not available. Please leave a message after the tone.
Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Hello — is anyone there?
Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Can you call back later? I'm at work.

scenarios.name: BEREAVED relative answers: patient has died -> sincere condolence, outcome other + note (never 'have a great day', never re-dial)

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Sam passed away back in March. This is his wife.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Says it is very sorry for her loss (no 'have a great day', no 'try again another time', nothing about an appointment) and calls outcome other with a note that the patient has died / should not be called. wrong_number and not_available are the wrong outcomes: the backend re-queues both for another dial.

scenarios.name: YES + 'stop ringing me' in one breath -> the do-not-call request wins over the silent yes

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Yes it's Sam, and I've asked you lot before, stop ringing me.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Says it has noted that for the clinic and calls outcome other with a DO NOT CALL note; does not go silent as if it were a plain yes.

scenarios.name: YES + 'I'm driving' -> driving wins: short goodbye, not_available, no pitch

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Yeah this is Sam, I'm just driving at the moment though.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Ends politely at once with the ring-us goodbye and outcome not_available; does not go silent, does not start the recall conversation.

scenarios.name: WHO'S THIS + 'not Sam's number' in one breath -> wrong_number, no 'are you Sam?' loop and nothing about check-ins or appointments

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Who's this? I don't know any Sam, I only got this number last month.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Apologises for the bother and calls wrong_number; does not repeat the who's-this line, does not ask again if they are Sam, says nothing about a check-in, booking or appointment.

scenarios.name: THIRD PARTY who is suspicious ('how did you get this number?') -> not_available, reveals nothing about visits or booking

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Sam's not here. Who is this and how did you get this number? What's it about?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Does not run the who's-this line ('I just wanted to check in with Sam. Are you Sam?') at someone who said Sam is out; says it will try another time and calls not_available; no appointment or booking detail.

scenarios.name: HAND-OVER ('hang on, I'll grab him') -> waits; does not hang up or call wrong_number

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Oh, hang on a sec, I'll just grab him for you.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Says it will hold (or says nothing) and makes no tool call; does not end the call and says nothing about the appointment.

scenarios.name: THIRD PARTY 'hold on, one sec' -> the identity table's hold line, not the call rules' 'take your time'

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Hold on, one sec.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Says it will hold ('Thank you, I'll hold.'); no tool call.

scenarios.name: 'NO, it's me' -> a yes: silent, no tool, no 'is he available?'

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
No — sorry, yes, it's me. I thought you were someone else.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Zero speech and no tool call: the platform moves on.

scenarios.name: BARE 'who?' -> the who-is-this line (identify + ask), not the vague line

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
Who?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Says it is AI Jane calling from Northside Physio trying to reach Sam and asks whether they are Sam; no tool call.

scenarios.name: 'I'm in a meeting' (no yes) -> can't-talk-now goodbye + not_available

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to check in about getting you back in for an appointment — is this Sam?
I'm in a meeting right now.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Short 'another time' goodbye and outcome not_available; no 30-seconds retry.
